verdict.rationale: The docs say each supported coding agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot, Antigravity, and others) is defined as a typed host config the generator uses, and adding a new host takes one file. A compressed AGENTS.md digest covers hosts without a full skill install, so the same collection targets many harnesses. Missing for 10: explicit per-harness install instructions in the evidence (beyond Claude Code's .claude/skills setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration of installs on non-Claude agents.
